dedupe_keys.name: maritime urban tracking full harbor sensor dataset

description: NTNU Autosight publishes the Maritime Urban Tracking dataset through NIRD Research Data Archive under CC BY 4.0. The own page describes a 773.3 GB collection from an autonomous ferry prototype in a harbor, with stereo cameras, LiDAR, RTK GNSS, inertial sensors and target-vessel position references. The article reports 19 tracking scenarios, eight calibration sequences, one mapping sequence and three docking scenarios recorded on two days in July 2024. These measurements can validate perception, tracking or vessel-agent components in maritime traffic simulations. A caveat is that the sensor rig, weather and vessel behaviours represent a narrow harbor campaign, not all marine operations. The archive is very large and requires careful sequence selection; a smaller Maneuver 1 subset has a separate DOI. I read the own archive metadata and article Data Records without downloading sensor files, processing video or evaluating tracking accuracy. No directly related catalogue record was identified. Coverage is one Norwegian harbor campaign, and NIRD makes sensor files available through its archive.
